info.name: Onshape REST Account Document API
Document
Get a list of documents that meet the criteria you specify.

params.name: q
params.description: Search for documents that contain the given string in the name. Search is not case-sensitive.

params.name: filter
params.description: Type of documents to search: `0: My Documents | 1: Created | 2: Shared | 3: Trash | 4: Public | 5: Recent | 6: By Owner | 7: By Company | 9: By Team`

params.name: owner
params.description: Owner ID. Can be a user ID, company ID, or team ID, depending on `ownerType`.

params.name: ownerType
params.description: Type of owner. `0: User | 1: Company | 2: Onshape`. If the owner is a teamId, leave this unspecified.

params.name: sortColumn
params.description: Column by which to sort search results. `name | modifiedAt | createdAt (default) | email | modifiedBy | promotedAt`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order. `desc` (descending, default), or `asc` (ascending).

params.name: label
params.description: Label

params.name: project
params.description: Project

params.name: parentId
params.description: Parent Id

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset. Determines where search results begin. Default value is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default value is 20 (also the maximum). Number of results returned can be less than this value. Use the `next` URL in the response to fetch the next page.

items.docs: Get a list of documents that meet the criteria you specify.

info.name: Download external data file(s) associated with the document.

items.docs:
* See [API Guide: Model Translation](https://onshape-public.github.io/docs/api-adv/translation/) for more details.
* If downloading an exported file, poll the `requestState` in the translation response and wait for a result of `DONE` before attempting to download the file. 
* Use the `resultExternalDataIds` from the translation response as the foreign id (`{fid}`) in this API.

info.name: Retrieve tabs and folders by document ID and workspace or version or microversion ID.

params.name: did
params.description: The id of the document in which to perform the operation.

params.name: linkDocumentId
params.description: The id of the document through which the above document should be accessed; only applicable when accessing a version of the document. This allows a user who has access to document a to see data from document b, as long as document b has been linked to document a by a user who has permission to both.

params.name: wvm
params.description: Indicates which of workspace (w), version (v), or document microversion (m) id is specified below.

params.name: wvmid
params.description: The id of the workspace, version or document microversion in which the operation should be performed.

params.name: elementType
params.description: If specified, information for elements of this type are returned. Note, the folder structure is not affected by this filter.

params.name: elementId
params.description: If specified, only the element with this id is returned. Note, the folder structure is not affected by this filter.

params.name: withZipContents
params.description: When true, returns the names of the files inside each zip file tab. Ignored if the document contains more than 10 zip files.

items.docs: Returns information on tabs and folders in the document.

items.docs: If anonymous access is allowed, you can allow or deny anonymous users the ability to export the document or publication. If `anonymousAccessAllowed=false` and `anonymousAllowsExport=true`, the call will throw an error.

info.name: Make a document public or private.

items.docs:
* Set `public=true` in the request body to make the document public. Set to `false` to make it private. Free users cannot make documents private. 
 * The `documentId` provided in the URL must match the one provided in the request body exactly.

info.name: Remove document View permissions from a user or other entity.

params.name: did
params.description: ID of the document to unshare.

params.name: eid
params.description: ID of the entity to remove permissions for. Uses `userId`, `companyId`, `teamId`, `documentId`, or `applicationId`, depending on the `entryType` value.

params.name: entryType
params.description: `0` (user) | `1` (company) | `2` (team) | `3` (document) | `4` (application) | `5` (connection_user)

items.docs: Specify the ID of the entity to unshare with in the `eid` field, and specify the type of entity being identified in the `entryType` field. For example, to unshare a document with a company, you would use `1` as the `entryType` value and the `companyId` as the `entityId`.
